newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close 2.30 pct up as blue chips gain.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close 2.30 pct up as blue chips gain.

text.p: Bangladesh shares finished higher on Thursday as blue chips gained for a fourth straight session, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index rose 55.31 points or 2.30 percent to 2,450.56. Of 85 traded issues, 61 gained and 24 lost. Turnover more than doubled to 97 million taka from Wednesday's 45.5 million.
"Investors are again out for good shares, but the correction in high-priced scrips is continuing," said one broker.
Beximco Pharmaceuticals gained 27.61 taka to 304.87 and Chittagong Cement shed 1,326.70 to 11,940.32.
